note: Canonical host/evaluator vocabulary. Prefer these IDs over inventing synonyms. Cross-link DOCTRINE, HOST_EVAL, VALIDATION, SCENE_INTELLIGENCE.

PLAYER_FIRST.definition: Explicit player-directed queue or command outranks autonomy, host suggestions, and optimization.

QUEUE_OBSERVATION.definition: Operator- or sensor-attested list of current/pending Sim interactions (ids/labels only). Not a Sims API hook.

GOOD_BEHAVIOR.definition: Queued action class that advances the highest-urgency unmet need (or preserves player direction) without forbidden save/resume actions.

BAD_BEHAVIOR.definition: Queued action that neglects critical motives, thrash-walks in-frame, or prefers fluff (read/skill/whim) over bladder/hunger/energy when those are critical.

EMULATE.definition: Reproduce the same intent class as the observed good queue (e.g. eat→eat). Does not invent new goals. May still route better under OPTIMIZE_ROUTING.

OPTIMIZE.definition: Replace or reorder a bad or suboptimal queue toward critical-need recovery using durable host transitions (map travel, cancel fluff). Never optimizes away player direction.

EMULATE_THEN_OPTIMIZE.definition: Keep the good intent, but change routing/latency (e.g. Manage Worlds / phone travel home instead of in-frame walk thrash).

IN_FRAME_WALK_THRASH.definition: Host failure mode: clicking distant same-lot objects so the Sim pathfinds endlessly within the PrintWindow frame. Forbidden when a map/travel transition reaches the lot that has the required object.

MAP_TRAVEL.definition: Host transition via Manage Worlds pin or phone travel to the destination lot, then Live object interaction. Preferred over IN_FRAME_WALK_THRASH for off-lot or missing-object critical recovery.

HOST_LISTENER.definition: Opt-in, bounded session that accepts queue/needs observations and runs host evaluators. Inactive until the operator activates it. Not a background daemon or GHA job.

HOST_EVALUATOR.definition: Read-only deterministic scorer over supplied observations (host_eval, instincts_host, behavior_eval, decision_eval). Does not click the game.

PROGRESSION_EVALUATOR.definition: Repository eval framework scoring vision markers, CI scaffolding, and GAME_CERTIFIED product progression rate. Offline green never raises product_progression_rate.

OUTDOOR_SOCIAL_DEFAULT.definition: Hosted-event failure mode: social interactions walk Sims outdoors (sidewalk/umbrella) while indoor venue capacity remains free.

EVENT_INDOOR_ROUTING.definition: Call-stack gate that cancels outdoor social prefix and grounds conversation indoors, preferring Sit and Chat Here before weaker Go Here / greet retargets.

SIT_AND_CHAT_HERE.definition: Sit and Chat Here: indoor seat pie-menu interaction that seats conversational partners and starts chat in place, preventing outdoor meetup re-routing.

SIT_AND_CHAT_HERE_INDOOR.definition: Preferred EVENT_INDOOR_ROUTING host route: click indoor sofa/chair/bench → Sit and Chat Here (locale-equivalent).

EVENT_BALANCE_STACK.definition: Host priority stack balancing player, viewport, survival needs, indoor routing, event goals, Fun-via-goals, homework, then other needs.

EVENT_GOAL_ACTION.definition: Concrete pie-menu or object interaction catalogued as satisfying a social-event HUD goal.

EVENT_GOAL_PLAN.definition: Host plan that maps incomplete event goals to prioritized indoor satisfying interactions and queue coverage.

FUN_SERVICE.definition: Independent Fun-need host evaluator with parallel activity lanes; peer to event/school services, not a monolith queue tail.

FUN_LANE.definition: One Fun activity family (portable, electronics, creative, playful, child) planned as its own service so Sims avoid piling onto contended objects.

FUN_CONTENTION.definition: Guests or sibling Sims occupy shared Fun objects; host prefers personal_portable and other free lanes.

NEED_SERVICES_TANDEM.definition: Host gate that plans hunger/bladder/energy/hygiene/fun/social as independent services in parallel and picks the primary READY need by motive urgency.

NEED_SERVICE_BASE.definition: P124 shared helpers (normalize needs, object freeness, lane planner) that every need service must reuse instead of reinventing parsers.

NEED_LANES.definition: Lane catalogs for non-Fun motives (hunger, bladder, energy, hygiene, social); Fun keeps contracts/fun-service.v1.json.

NEED_SERVICE_HEALTH.definition: Per-microsystem probe result HEALTHY, DEGRADED, UNHEALTHY, or YIELDED used by need load balance.

NEED_SERVICE_DETACH.definition: Remove an unhealthy need microsystem from the primary selection pool and abandon its sticky call stack.

ASSUMPTION_WINDOW.definition: Fresh exploration frame after detach: scene reset, cleared sticky assumptions, and reweighted alternate options for that need avenue.

NEED_LOAD_BALANCE.definition: Host orchestration that health-checks tandem need services, detaches unhealthy stacks, opens assumption windows, and picks primary among healthy READY siblings.

DOMAIN_CASCADE.definition: Ordered poll bus that emits cascading receipts across needs (with LB), budget, career, skills/whims, and relationships on each observation — not a background daemon.

CAREER_SERVICES_TANDEM.definition: Peer microsystem that tracks career-panel obligations (teen High School Student homework) beside need_services so agents do not drop schoolwork while needs dominate.

CAREER_OBLIGATION_HELD.definition: Sticky career daily-task continuity flag: homework remains owed across survival suspensions until explicit homework_pending=false clears it.

CAREER_READY_AFTER_NEEDS.definition: Host gate after survival recovers: resume teen homework policy from the sticky career obligation instead of forgetting the career panel task.

ASPIRATION_SERVICES_TANDEM.definition: Peer microsystem that judges aspiration and life-state dialogs beside need_services and career_service so occult transformations cannot silently rewrite the needs engine.

ASPIRATION_PROMPT_HELD.definition: Sticky aspiration/life-state dialog continuity flag: the OK/Cancel prompt remains tracked across needs-focused tandem turns until cleared or judged.

ASPIRATION_COMPLETION_ENABLED.definition: Operator toggle: when true, aspiration milestones may advance; life-state mutations still require occult-needs readiness. Product default true; lab host default false.

BALANCE_SERVICES_TANDEM.definition: Peer microsystem that tracks Enchanted by Nature Balance/Imbalance meter and physical ailments beside need_services so agents do not drop Naturopath/Holistic Cure/nature recovery while needs dominate.

BALANCE_CONDITION_HELD.definition: Sticky imbalance/ailment continuity flag: Imbalanced or Very Imbalanced (with optional physical ailment) remains tracked across survival suspensions until Balanced clears it.

BALANCE_READY_AFTER_NEEDS.definition: Host gate after survival recovers: resume Naturopath/Holistic Cure or nature-balance recovery from the sticky balance condition instead of forgetting the wellness meter.

ASPIRATION_COMPLETION_DISABLED.definition: Host gate when aspiration completion is off: Cancel life-state and aspiration-completion dialogs (e.g. Mother Nature fairy summon) so base needs work is not derailed.

MOODLET_STRIP.definition: Bottom-left Sim emotion and moodlet icons. Host logic requires supplied labels; absence is SENSOR_NOT_SUPPLIED.

MOODLET_AWARE_ROUTING.definition: Call-stack gate that folds tense/uncomfortable moodlets into indoor retarget and survival-aligned relief.

SIM_PROFILE_INSPECT.definition: Read-only gate that normalizes supplied Simology/skills/preferences/whims with moodlets. Never practice_skill or BI-005.

SIMOLOGY_PANEL.definition: Live Sim Info Simology surface for traits and aspiration. Distinct from host-menu select_sim_to_play and compatibility patch profiles.

PLAYER_DISCOVERY_MAP.definition: Documented HUD locations where a player can inspect moodlets, whims, Simology, skills, and likes/dislikes for the active Sim.

PROOF_CEILING.definition: Explicit maximum claim allowed for an artifact (e.g. OFFLINE, LOCAL_OBSERVED, NOT_LIVE_CERT).

LOCAL_OBSERVED.definition: Observed on a real local game session with capture/receipt; not GAME_CERTIFIED and not CI-substitutable.

GAME_CERTIFIED.definition: Maintainer-accepted live certification for an exact patch/module after BI-002 gates. Offline green never grants this.

PLAYER_PRESENT_ON_CANVAS.definition: Foreground window is the Sims client AND cursor lies inside the game client rectangle.

PLAYER_PLAYING.definition: Operator is actively playing: on-canvas presence, recent input within grace, operator-declared playing, or player-directed queue. Host must YIELD_TO_PLAYER.

HOST_MAY_AUTOMATE.definition: Opt-in session is ACTIVE, presence is not PLAYER_PLAYING, and probe succeeded. Host may evaluate and, only with explicit --execute, SendInput.

YIELD_TO_PLAYER.definition: Host refuses SendInput and does not rewrite the queue because the player is playing or presence is unknown.

HOST_AUTOMATE.definition: Presence-gated orchestrator that runs behavior_eval + host_stack + needs_force plans when HOST_MAY_AUTOMATE; never a default background daemon.

HOUSEHOLD_FUNDS.definition: Observed or operator-supplied Simoleon balance for the active disposable household. Host money-stat input; not a save-file edit.

FEDERAL_SUBSIDY_PROMPT.definition: When funds are below 100, host shows a Sims-styled HOUSEHOLD NOTICE offering a Simolean federal bank boost; Yes runs durable funds inject.

FUNDS_INJECT.definition: Mode-agnostic cheat sequence: Ctrl+Shift+C → testingcheats enabled true → Money N (best-effort) → motherlode chunks. Never force F1; never claimed as BI-004 earned income.

DIY_SKILL_FORCE.definition: Mode-agnostic cheat planner that levels adult Major_* skills on the currently selected Sim/Servo via stats.set_skill_level, then confirms offered mastery/reward-trait OK dialogs. Includes DIY maker and full_unlock bundles. Sibling to FUNDS_INJECT; never practice_skill or BI-005 certification.

UPGRADE_PARTS_FORCE.definition: Host planner that stocks named upgrade/DIY parts via spawn bulk or phone/computer Order. Evolved into HOUSEHOLD_DIY_PARTS_BUDGET; pocket inventory only; never gsi_create_obj hex or BI-002 closure.

HOUSEHOLD_DIY_PARTS_BUDGET.definition: Per-Sim pocket stock for every observed household member N: DIY builder kit (common/electronic/plumbing/kitchen upgrade parts, robot salvage, computer chip, mechanism) with spawn-first acquisition and machine-readable cert schema.

DIY_BUILDER_KIT.definition: Canonical set of pocket craft/upgrade materials every household Sim should hold at budget target so DIY builds and Tune Up are not blocked by missing parts.

COMPUTER_PURCHASE_UPGRADE_PARTS.definition: Vanilla Live path: phone or computer → Order → Purchase Upgrade Parts → select a buyable upgrade/salvage part; delivers to Sim pocket inventory.

ROBOT_SALVAGE_PARTS.definition: Discover University robotics crafting/tune-up material. Observed Tune Up miss: 4 units. Prefer Spawn Crafting Supplies bulk; Order purchase remains valid.

DIY_PARTS_BUDGET_CERT.definition: Machine-readable receipt (betterinstincts.diy-parts-budget.cert/v1) scoring each household member × DIY kit part as UNKNOWN/SHORT/MET from attested pocket counts; never auto-certified from plans alone.

ACCEPT_OFFERED_REWARD_TRAIT.definition: During DIY_SKILL_FORCE execute, press Enter and primary OK hotspot for offered skill-mastery / reward-trait dialogs (e.g. Perfectionist-style). Never Cancel; not aspiration life-state, invite OK, or CAS quiz Okay.

TYPE_TEXT_KEYBD_EVENT.definition: Preferred Sims cheat-console typing path via VkKeyScan + keybd_event. KEYEVENTF_UNICODE alone is a silent miss on some TS4 DirectInput hosts.

FULL_UNLOCK_BUNDLE.definition: All-the-way adult skill set: max catalogued Major_* skills at level 10 so activities and unlockables are not gated. Missing packs may no-op individual lines.

DIY_MAKER_BUNDLE.definition: DIY-only skill set: handiness + robotics + fabrication + programming at level 10 unless overridden.

SERVO_CORE_BUNDLE.definition: Lean Servo DIY skill set: handiness + robotics + programming (omits Fabrication when Eco Lifestyle is absent).

STATS_SET_SKILL_LEVEL.definition: Console command form stats.set_skill_level <Major_Skill> <1-10> applied to the active selected Sim after testingcheats. Host convenience only — not BI-005 skill growth proof.

TESTINGCHEATS_ENABLED_TRUE.definition: Required console activation command before Money inject. Skipping it is a known live failure mode.

CHEAT_CONSOLE_CHORD.definition: Ctrl+Shift+C opens the Sims cheat console on PC in Live, Build, or Buy. Host funds inject must press this chord before testingcheats/Money/motherlode — never skip, never force F1 to open it.

MODE_AGNOSTIC_FUNDS_INJECT.definition: Funds inject that preserves the operator's current mode (Live/Build/Buy); never forces F1 or Esc-spam while they build.

EARN_INCOME_CRITICAL.definition: Money-stat urgency when funds are desperate; earn path is never suppressed by purchase lockdown.

HOST_CRISIS_ANTI_PATTERN.definition: School Join (or leaving home) while needs/funds are critical — stranded the lab off-lot; Send Alone is mandatory.

LOT_ENVIRONMENT_GAIN.definition: Build/Buy item stat that raises room Environment Score toward Decorated / Beautifully Decorated Happy moodlets; stacks per wall panel.

ECO_FOOTPRINT_GREEN.definition: Eco Lifestyle lot contribution toward neighborhood Clean Air / green utopia moodlets; mutually exclusive maximize objective vs industrial.

ECO_FOOTPRINT_INDUSTRIAL.definition: Eco Lifestyle lot contribution toward smog / Gross Air; opt-in storytelling maximize only — excluded from green/balanced household defaults.

BUILD_OPTIMIZE_PLAN.definition: Evaluate-only ranked Build/Buy catalog receipt for a stated objective; execute_allowed stays false until disposable Build Mode P08 proof.

BUILD_YIELD_MICROSYSTEM.definition: Evaluate-only Build/Buy owner that maintains per-category best-value pools for environment, neighborhood eco footprint, and bill axes; yield over aesthetics.

CATEGORY_BEST_POOL.definition: Top attested items in one Build/Buy category for a value axis (Env, Green, bills); host chooses from the pool rather than inventing aesthetics rankings.

CATEGORY_ITEM_HIERARCHY.definition: Ordered best-item dictionary for one Build/Buy category under a yield objective (Env / Green / bills); expands CATEGORY_BEST_POOL into a ranked list.

COUNTERTOP_PLACEMENT.definition: Machine-readable Sims 4 countertop rules: standard vs island kinds, Auto-Counters gear shapes/corners, Env cap 2, and barstool-only seating snap on island overhangs.

ISLAND_COUNTER.definition: Counter surface with overhang that admits barstool seating snap; selected via catalog island piece or Auto-Counters gear shapes.

STANDARD_COUNTER.definition: Counter surface without overhang; affords food prep/sinks/appliances but never seating snap.

BARSTOOL_SEATING_SNAP.definition: Only barstools snap to island-counter overhangs; dining chairs never snap to any counter kind.

BILL_POWER.definition: Catalog power-draw axis; lower is better for household utility bills. Null means axis not declared for that item.

BILL_WATER.definition: Catalog water-use axis; lower is better for household utility bills. Null means axis not declared for that item.

LOT_ENVIRONMENT_MODEL.definition: Durable, revisioned structured understanding of a lab lot (entities, relations, goals, captures) that accumulates across observations and mutation outcomes.

RECURSIVE_LOT_MODEL.definition: Selected P95 architecture: plan and mutate from the accumulating lot model; checkpoints persist the same revisioned understanding rather than wiping it.

BLANK_SLATE_REASSESS.definition: Forbidden loop: act, discard prior lot understanding, capture/checkpoint from scratch, and reassess as if the lot were unknown.

HOUSE_STATE_MUTATION_LEASE.definition: Admission gate for one Build/Buy mutation bound to the current lot-model revision and explicit entity targets; outcome must merge back into the same model.

BUILD_INTEGRITY.definition: Structure-first Build/Buy spatial gate: indoor vs outdoor domains, floor-before-furniture, no nesting, protected aesthetic zones.

STRUCTURE_FIRST_SPATIAL_ADMISSION.definition: Selected P95 Build architecture: admit mutations only after domain/zone/floor claims satisfy integrity; restore floor and walls before furniture.

OUTDOOR_AS_INDOOR.definition: Forbidden integrity violation: treating lot grass/outdoor grid as an interior floor for indoor-class objects.

PLACE_WITHOUT_FLOOR.definition: Forbidden: placing indoor furniture when the lot model has no attested present INDOOR_FLOOR tile.

BUILD_SPATIAL.definition: Host Build/Buy classification of enclosure (INSIDE/OUTSIDE) and story (FLOOR_1/FLOOR_2) used to order intelligent construction.

ENCLOSURE_AND_STORY_AXES.definition: Selected P95 builder architecture: every entity/placement is typed as inside vs outside and first vs second floor before mutation admission.

FLOOR_1.definition: Ground / first story of an indoor structure; must exist before FLOOR_2 indoor work.

BUILD_FLOOR_ACTIVITY.definition: Opt-in host listener peer that classifies Build Mode work by active story, single vs multi-floor span, and attested item-census themes for later optimize hints.

FLOOR_ACTIVITY_CENSUS.definition: Selected P95 architecture: attested active_story + stories_touched + floor_items drive activity span and per-floor themes; pixel height alone is never story proof.

FLOOR_THEME.definition: Majority theme inferred for a story from attested item categories (kitchen, bedroom, outdoor_garden, etc.); advisory seed for build_optimize hints.

FLOOR_2.definition: Upper / second story; indoor work is denied until FLOOR_1 indoor floor is present in the lot model.

BUILD_LIBRARY_CHECKPOINT.definition: Host gate requiring an attested Sims My Library building save before room or structure mutation; preserves operator revert judgment.

LIBRARY_SAVE_BEFORE_ROOM_MUTATE.definition: Selected P95 architecture: SAVE_TO_LIBRARY / library_checkpoint must precede sledge, wall tools, move-house, and structure-target mutations; game Save As is not a substitute.

SAVE_TO_LIBRARY.definition: Build Mode action that saves the current building/room into Sims My Library; the only mutation that creates library_checkpoint without requiring a prior one.

SCHOOL_DAY_GOAL_PROGRESS.definition: Host gate that queues incomplete High School Years top-left school-day HUD goals when needs are not survival-critical.

HOMEWORK_PREMISES_BLOCKED.definition: Career-panel homework is deferred while the Sim is on school premises or an active school day.

SURVIVAL_BEFORE_HOMEWORK.definition: Teen hunger/bladder/energy below threshold outrank career-panel homework queueing.

HOMEWORK_INVENTORY_MISSING.definition: Teen homework daily task remains due but supplied inventory_has_homework=false triggers recovery ladder; lot-scan Put in Inventory outranks computer recovery unless homework_on_lot=false.

LOT_SCAN_PUT_HOMEWORK_IN_INVENTORY.definition: Host recovery route: scan current-lot surfaces for the homework book, click it, Put in Inventory, then queue do-homework.

SOCIAL_LOOKUP_REQUIRED.definition: Invite-over dialog active; host must uniquely look up invitee in Sims library before OK.

SOCIAL_OPPORTUNITY_OK_ALLOWED.definition: Unique Sims-library match with allowlisted occult status; app may press OK.

CAMERA_LOT_IS_NOT_SIM_PREMISES.definition: Viewport/camera lot differs from active Sim premises; sim_at_school/effective_location_kind drive homework gates.

CAMERA_SAFE_TRAVERSE.definition: Host-owned bounded camera plan that gathers lot data without parking the mouse in the screen-edge pan band; every plan ends at SAFE_CURSOR_REST.

SAFE_CURSOR_REST.definition: Mandatory interior cursor park outside the Sims edge-pan band after any camera step so the viewport stops drifting while agents develop.

EDGE_MOUSE_PARK.definition: Bad practice: leaving the cursor in the screen-edge pan band so the camera keeps scrolling after the agent stops navigating.

CONTINUOUS_EDGE_HOLD.definition: Bad practice: holding edge-scroll to scan the lot while planning or coding instead of host-owned capture/pan steps.

CAPTURE_BEFORE_EDGE_SCAN.definition: Prefer PrintWindow capture + lot-model observe before any camera pan; edge scrolling is not the default sensor.

CAMERA_SAFE_REST.definition: Host gate that parks the cursor at SAFE_CURSOR_REST when an edge-band park is detected; outranks needs clicks.

QUEUE_TEEN_HOMEWORK.definition: Queue DO_HOMEWORK / WORK_ON_HOMEWORK when teen inventory_has_homework=true at home.

HOMEWORK_AFTER_NEEDS_QUEUE.definition: Finish toilet/shower/eat queue items before teen homework when survival is green.

PINNED_WHIM_SEDENTARY.definition: Pinned Not Stumble prefers sedentary stumble_safe school actions such as Study for Exams.

SCENARIO_GOAL_PROGRESS.definition: Host gate that queues incomplete scenario scoring HUD goals when survival needs are green and school day does not outrank.

SCENARIO_CAREER_DEFERRED.definition: Scenario get_career goal is blocked until allow_career, needs_game_certified, and income_game_observed; earn/craft precede career.

NAVIGATING_NEEDS_TANDEM.definition: Host gate that queues Discovery Quest Navigating Needs panel goals aligned to linked motives by urgency, instead of inventing parallel need fluff.

URGENT_NEED_WITHOUT_PANEL_GOAL.definition: An urgent motive is not covered by currently incomplete Navigating Needs panel goals; fall through to need_services (then instincts) rather than waiting on a non-visible discovery goal.

BUILD_OR_BUY_YIELD.definition: Host abstains from Navigating Needs / needs-object clicks while Build or Buy mode is active; never force Live (F1) on the operator.

CURIOUS_CATALOG.definition: Opt-in immersive chance-card workflow for hidden Buy rare/money gardening objects via bb.showhiddenobjects. Never autoruns; never touches game speed; never types buydebug.

SHOW_HIDDEN_OBJECTS.definition: Durable console line bb.showhiddenobjects (buydebug is a nickname only). Requires testingcheats first; one command per line. Elementary unlock for household useful-item catalog/hidden and fabrication rows — Better BuildBuy never substitutes.

HOUSEHOLD_OBJECT_FORCE.definition: Reusable host catalog and planner that forces named useful objects into any Sims household via careers.promote deposits or catalog search after elementary bb.showhiddenobjects unlock. Forbids hallucinated gsi_create_obj hex IDs.

ELEMENTARY_HIDDEN_UNLOCK.definition: Required testingcheats true then bb.showhiddenobjects before any catalog_search or fabrication force row. TwistedMexi Better BuildBuy is optional catalog UX only and must never replace this unlock.

USEFUL_ITEM_CATALOG.definition: Machine-owned BetterInstincts list of forceable household objects (Out of This World Desktop, Cruelty-Free Meat Wall, UFO Bed, Captain Sigma, Eco-Matic Smog Vacuum, Hydroponic Planter, optional Positronic Pro).

UI_CHROME.definition: Named Build/Buy/Live chrome targets as normalized client fractions plus per-mode hotkey glossary and catalog deposit recipes; peer to ui_mode, not a vision clicker.

HOST_UI_MAP.definition: Resolution-profile keyed map of clickable chrome (search field, catalog result, household inventory tab, extensible Live panels) resolved by definition for host adapters.

HOTKEY_GLOSSARY.definition: Per-mode keyboard chord catalog (F1/F2/F3, Backspace→Household Inventory, Esc cancel hold, cheat console). Intent hints only — never mode proof or execute authority.

CATALOG_TO_HOUSEHOLD_INVENTORY.definition: Evaluate-only recipe: search → select → Backspace deposit into Household Inventory without lot placement. AOK Bloomer is the first catalog item.

AOK_BLOOMER_SEARCH.definition: Operator-preferred Build/Buy catalog search term AOK for the A-OK-Bloomer Vertical Garden (~§365 Eco Lifestyle).

SITUATION.definition: Changing bounded game context; ontology concept, not a claim that a screenshot alone establishes state.

DOMAIN_CAPABILITY.definition: Open-domain semantic registration; adding a new future domain does not require a closed list change.

GOAL_THREAD.definition: Durable player-compatible intention that survives interruptions and requires fresh validation on resumption.

ACTIVITY.definition: Candidate or ongoing work serving a goal; evaluation and execution are distinct.

RESOURCE_CLAIM.definition: Scoped contention for objects, time, funds, attention or interaction capacity.

TIME_WINDOW.definition: Evidence-qualified temporal opportunity or deadline; unverified time bounds do not become facts.

CONTINGENCY.definition: Observed situation that can cause safe reprioritization without granting host control.

INTERRUPTION.definition: Recorded suspension of activity with its intent, reason and required recheck.

RESUME_CONDITION.definition: Condition for reconsidering an interrupted goal without blindly replaying an action.

MECHANIC_PATH.definition: Game-native action/tuning route or a separately justified extension, both still subject to admission.

COORDINATION_CYCLE.definition: Bounded join over existing domain poll receipts and shared constraints, returning suggestions only.

ROOM_CENSUS.definition: Read-only whole-lot projection of attested floor/zone/entity observations; never a second owner or autonomous scan.

ROOM_ZONE_ATTESTED.definition: Room grouping supported by an explicitly observed ROOM_ZONE structural claim; no implication that vision-only geometry was certified.

ROOM_ZONE_CANDIDATE.definition: Item co-location grouped by an attested zone without structural room verification; no authority for wall changes.

MULTI_LABEL_ROOM_FUNCTION.definition: Non-exclusive, scored-from-items functional room classifications such as living+dining+office.

ROOM_STYLE_EVIDENCE.definition: Multiple room aesthetics aggregated solely from attested object style_tags; an object label alone cannot prove a style.

ROOM_CENSUS_COVERAGE.definition: Every floor represented in current model, never assertion that every actual game floor was inspected or a room discovered from raw pixels.

HOTKEY_FIRST_WHEN_EQUIVALENT.definition: Cooperative input preference: use catalogued hotkeys/KEY chords before mouse CLICK_TARGET when an equivalent exists; mouse is MOUSE_FALLBACK only. Improves ASYNC_INTEROP by avoiding cursor fights; never proves mode or grants execute.
